headline: Google Photos ditches clunky bottom bar with new cleaner UI
summary: Google Photos gets a revamped UI with a floating bar and new features
details: Google Photos is rolling out a new UI with a floating bar featuring Photos, Collections, and Create. The update aims to provide a cleaner look and make background images more prominent.
The new design replaces the chunky navigation bar at the bottom of the screen. The Search option will now be located separately.

Additionally, Google Photos is introducing a Video Remix feature, powered by Gemini, allowing users to relight videos, swap backgrounds, and apply filters. This feature requires a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra plan.
The update is currently rolling out to users, but may not be available yet on all devices.
caption:
Google Photos just got a major UI overhaul. What's new?

Google Photos is rolling out a new UI with a floating bar featuring Photos, Collections, and Create. The update aims to provide a cleaner look and make background images more prominent.

The new design replaces the chunky navigation bar at the bottom of the screen. The Search option will now be located separately.

Additionally, Google Photos is introducing a Video Remix feature, powered by Gemini, allowing users to relight videos, swap backgrounds, and apply filters. This feature requires a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra plan.

The update is currently rolling out to users, but may not be available yet on all devices.
